title: Query Active AGV Errors From the WCS Database
summary: Retrieve current active AGV error records from the WCS database by logging into the WCS primary server, opening the WCS database, creating a new query tab, entering the documented SQL query against [Helix2x_1Prod_Robotics].[dbo].[SystemActiveErrorModel], executing it, and reviewing the returned results.
when_to_use: Use this procedure when active AGV error records need to be retrieved from the WCS database for investigation or visibility.
not_for: Do not use this procedure as a corrective action for AGV errors; the source only provides retrieval steps.
Do not use this procedure when WCS primary server or WCS database access is unavailable.

roles_and_responsibilities.responsibility: Log into the WCS primary server, access the WCS database, run the documented SQL query, and review the returned active AGV error records.

safety_notes: This is a source-backed diagnostic retrieval procedure.
The source does not provide corrective actions for returned errors; use the output for investigation only.

steps.title: Use the documented active AGV error query text
